movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Use of the handkerchief as an expressive tool for flirting and signaling.
movement_profile.footwork: Barefoot, involving rhythmic steps and zapateo-like movements.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Couple dance, moving in relation to one another.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Visible hip and waist movements mimicking cockfighting.
movement_profile.partnering: Courtship-based; the man pursues and the woman evades.
movement_profile.posture: Upright but fluid, reflecting the 'errant' nature of the dance.

signature_moves.description: Aggressive, stallion-like movements by the man and evasive, flirting movements by the woman.
signature_moves.name: Cockfight mimicry

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Starts with a steady, tragic pace and accelerates into an explosive, fast-paced fuga.

music_profile.sound_description: A rhythmic, guitar-led sound characterized by the 'tundete' bass line and the percussive 'Golpe de Tierra' from cajóns and handclaps, punctuated by emotive, mournful vocals.
music_profile.vocal_style: Tragic, picaresque ballad-style singing (triste or cumanana)

basic_steps: Use of the handkerchief to signal flirtation
Coordinated hip and torso movements mimicking cockfighting
teaching.level_notes: Requires high energy and expressive, picaresque attitude.
